item.title: Sharpening the cut: physical origins of rejection-curve broadening and routes to precision ultrafiltration
item.description:
Authors: Jamila G. Eatman, Chaoqiuyu Wang, Paul F. Nealey, Seth B. Darling

Ultrafiltration (UF) and loose nanofiltration (LNF) are effective strategies for a low-cost, scalable solute separation. Achieving highly selective separations in these regimes requires tackling several sources of broadening in the rejection curve.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00362a

item.title: Visualizing energy transfer across a hexagonal Cs 4 PbBr 6 microdisk using single-particle spectroscopy
item.description:
Authors: Soumik De, Mrinal Kanti Panda, Subhadip Ghosh

Spatial mapping of energy transfer in hexagonal Cs 4 PbBr 6 perovskite microdisks reveals enhanced core efficiency due to increased dye occupancy in structural cavities.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00287k
